title: Stochastic invariance in infinite dimension beyond Lipschitz coefficients
summary: We establish necessary and sufficient conditions for stochastic invariance of closed subsets in Hilbert spaces for solutions to infinite-dimensional stochastic differential equations (SDEs) under mild assumptions on the coefficients. Our first characterization is formulated in terms of certain normal vectors to the invariance set and requires differentiability only of the dispersion operator, but not of the diffusion coefficient itself.
